components.name: Microsoft C/C++ runtime (static, /MT)

license.name: Microsoft Visual Studio license terms (distributable code)

components.description: Linked statically into VirtualVessel.Capture.Native.dll (native/capture), VirtualVessel.Encode.Native.dll (native/encode), and VirtualVessel.Audio.Native.dll (native/audio), so users need no Visual C++ redistributable. The version is the toolset of the machine that builds the DLLs. Windows system libraries (d3d11, dxgi, user32; Media Foundation's mfplat, mfreadwrite, mfuuid, and ole32 for the encoder, whose H.264 encoder is the system's or the GPU driver's; WASAPI through ole32 and avrt for the audio engine) are only linked against and not distributed.

Not required, not in the repository, and not distributed.
